dependencies.acceptanceCondition: The controller, manifest schema, matrix digest, and dependency graph validate; status continues to report M3 NOT COMPLETE until all external and real-host exit criteria pass.
dependencies.description: The read-only stage controller, customer-input manifest validator, matrix status report, and dependency graph are implemented. Local test evidence is recorded separately from customer qualification.
dependencies.failureBehavior: Malformed manifests, schema drift, matrix digest drift, and fixture input fail closed; no external action is invoked.
dependencies.nextAction: Run the local controller tests and inspect the machine-readable status report.
dependencies.owner: Kordex maintainer
dependencies.requiredInputOrDecision: No external input for local use; keep controller validation and local fixtures explicitly non-production.

dependencies.acceptanceCondition: The pinned Skopeo package source, signer, package identity, executable path, version, and digest pass the local inspect check on the operator environment.
dependencies.description: Pinned Skopeo acquisition, provenance verification, installation, and runtime inspection are implemented; the current local environment passes the pinned executable check.
dependencies.failureBehavior: A different local environment without the pinned Skopeo package remains blocked by the inspect stage; this repository status does not establish customer registry verification.
dependencies.nextAction: No repository action remains; use the inspect stage on each operator environment and keep private registry verification gated on customer credentials and evidence.
dependencies.owner: Kordex operator/tooling owner
dependencies.requiredInputOrDecision: No customer input is needed for the current local environment; any new environment must verify the repository-pinned Skopeo package before inspection.
dependencies.validationCommand: command -v skopeo; then python3 scripts/m3_qualification.py inspect

dependencies.acceptanceCondition: The customer root signature verifies against independently sourced root material, and every required public trust identity is authorized, valid, non-revoked, role-bound, and delivered without private key material.
dependencies.description: Customer-rooted trust configuration for maintenance, release, artifact, collector, reviewer, image-risk approver, and trust-state attestor roles has not been supplied or independently verified.
dependencies.failureBehavior: Unsigned, expired, revoked, unknown, substituted, caller-asserted, or rolled-back trust remains BLOCKED.
dependencies.nextAction: Customer security custodian supplies the root-signed trust configuration and independently sourced root verification material.
dependencies.owner: Customer security and trust custodian
dependencies.requiredInputOrDecision: Provide the root-authorized public trust configuration, detached root signature, generation, key provenance, validity/revocation status, and identity-role inventory through the approved secure channel; never provide private keys.

dependencies.acceptanceCondition: The customer backend passes the existing conformance suite and independent review for durable reads, atomic compare-and-swap, monotonic generations, rollback/conflict rejection, restart durability, and lost-ack reconciliation.
dependencies.description: The monotonic trust-state client contract exists, but no customer-selected durable backend has passed independent conformance or been configured for production.
dependencies.failureBehavior: Unavailable, stale, conflicting, non-durable, or unreviewed monotonic state prevents trust acceptance; no local fallback exists.
dependencies.nextAction: Customer platform owner selects the backend and runs the conformance suite against its isolated customer endpoint.
dependencies.owner: Customer security/platform team
dependencies.requiredInputOrDecision: Select and operate a customer-controlled durable atomic compare-and-swap backend; provide root-bound backend identity, namespace, attestor identity, and independently reviewed conformance report.
dependencies.validationCommand: Customer adapter invokes scripts/m3_trust_state_conformance.py:run_conformance in an isolated namespace; synthetic unit tests are not customer conformance.

dependencies.acceptanceCondition: The customer replay registry passes its conformance suite and independent signed review for atomic unique claims, durable replay rejection, identity binding, and lost-ack handling.
dependencies.description: A production customer-controlled replay registry and independently verified atomic/durable conformance evidence are absent.
dependencies.failureBehavior: Registry outage, ambiguous response, duplicate claim, lost acknowledgement, or local/mock-only behavior blocks acceptance.
dependencies.nextAction: Customer platform owner selects and deploys the replay registry, then obtains independent protocol conformance review.
dependencies.owner: Customer security/platform team
dependencies.requiredInputOrDecision: Select a durable customer replay registry that authenticates identities and atomically binds customer, project, run ID, nonce, matrix digest, trust generation, manifest digest, and state; provide signed conformance evidence and receipts.
dependencies.validationCommand: Customer adapter invokes scripts/m3_replay_registry_conformance.py:run_conformance against its isolated customer endpoint; retain the independent signed review.

dependencies.acceptanceCondition: The root-authorized identity records verify with independently confirmed fingerprints, current validity and revocation state, required roles, and distinct operator/corroborator/attestor/reviewer identities.
dependencies.description: Authorized and distinct collector, reviewer, corroborator, trust-state attestor, and image-risk approver identities have not been supplied.
dependencies.failureBehavior: Unknown, duplicate, expired, revoked, caller-selected, or same-person/key reviewer identities are rejected.
dependencies.nextAction: Customer security custodian assigns distinct authorized identities and supplies their public verification records.
dependencies.owner: Customer security custodian and independent reviewer
dependencies.requiredInputOrDecision: Root-authorized public keys and identity records with calculated fingerprints, roles, validity, revocation, and separation-of-duty evidence.

dependencies.acceptanceCondition: The signed owner approval and independent evidence bind the exact project, image self-link and numeric ID to Debian 13, the approved point release, linux/amd64, and the installed guest identity.
dependencies.description: No exact approved Debian 13 point release image, immutable image ID, owner approval, and independent installed-release evidence is supplied.
dependencies.failureBehavior: A family name, claimed release, digest, or image ID without independently verified owner/release evidence remains UNVERIFIED or BLOCKED.
dependencies.nextAction: Debian image owner provides the exact approved image record and independent OS-release evidence.
dependencies.owner: Debian image owner and independent image reviewer
dependencies.requiredInputOrDecision: Exact Debian 13 release, amd64 image project/self-link/server image ID, signed image approval, and independent evidence proving the installed OS identity.

dependencies.acceptanceCondition: The signed owner approval, entitlement evidence, and independent review bind a genuine Red Hat-supported RHEL 9.8-or-later image ID to its exact minor release and linux/amd64 guest identity.
dependencies.description: No exact approved genuine RHEL 9.8-or-later image, entitlement basis, image owner approval, or independent release evidence is supplied.
dependencies.failureBehavior: RHEL below 9.8, derivatives, unverified images, or missing entitlement and owner approval remain blocked.
dependencies.nextAction: RHEL owner selects an approved image and provides the exact release and subscription evidence.
dependencies.owner: RHEL image/subscription owner and independent image reviewer
dependencies.requiredInputOrDecision: Exact RHEL 9 minor release, amd64 image project/self-link/server image ID, subscription/entitlement evidence, signed approval, and independent genuine-RHEL identity evidence.

dependencies.acceptanceCondition: For each selected required OS, signed repository metadata and policy-bound package artifacts pass preflight with exact hashes, architecture, baseline delta, private mirror, kernel expectation, and reboot policy.
dependencies.description: Approved immutable Debian and RHEL repositories, signing identities, exact package policies, package archives, and kernel/reboot expectations are absent.
dependencies.failureBehavior: Missing, unsigned, mutable, mismatched, or no-op package changes block host qualification.
dependencies.nextAction: Repository owners deliver package metadata and artifacts; change approver binds the real package change and reboot policy.
dependencies.owner: Debian/RHEL repository owners and customer change approver
dependencies.requiredInputOrDecision: Signed Trixie APT and RHEL RPM metadata, pinned repository snapshots, baseline/target package versions and architectures, package digests, expected kernel, and reboot policy. Include per-platform m3_artifact_preflight.py inputs and deterministic reports; controller rechecks local freshness and policy binding but never treats an unsigned report hash as independent approval.

dependencies.acceptanceCondition: The exact approved K3s binary and system-image archive pass separate signature-domain verification against independent customer trust, with pinned version, architecture, digest, acquisition record, and private mappings.
dependencies.description: Approved K3s v1.36.6+k3s1 binary and system-image archive, locks, signatures, acquisition records, and trust are absent.
dependencies.failureBehavior: Missing or mismatched signature, lock, version, architecture, or digest blocks bootstrap; no public fallback is allowed.
dependencies.nextAction: K3s approver supplies the signed, customer-approved binary and image archive package.
dependencies.owner: K3s artifact approver
dependencies.requiredInputOrDecision: Customer-approved amd64 binary, signed binary lock, system-image archive, separately domain-signed image lock, trust bundle, and acquisition/approval record.
dependencies.validationCommand: cd api && GOPROXY=off GOSUMDB=off GOTOOLCHAIN=local go run ./cmd/kordex-artifact-lock system-images verify --help

dependencies.acceptanceCondition: The release bundle, six-image digest lock, tool-provenance lock, signatures, public keys, and signer allowlist pass their existing verifiers with independently confirmed signer identities.
dependencies.description: Signed Kordex release bundle, detached signature, image digest lock, tool provenance, and Helm signer allowlist have not been supplied.
dependencies.failureBehavior: Missing trust, signature, image mapping, architecture, or digest leaves artifact preflight blocked.
dependencies.nextAction: Release and build owners provide the approved signed release and provenance package.
dependencies.owner: Kordex release/build owners and customer security custodian
dependencies.requiredInputOrDecision: Release bundle and detached signature, six-image immutable digest lock, tool provenance lock/signature/public key, and approved Helm signer identities.

dependencies.acceptanceCondition: The read-only registry verifier reports PASS for all eight K3s and six Kordex images at the approved digests and linux/amd64 through the approved private route, with no public fallback.
dependencies.description: The customer registry has not been populated with the approved eight K3s and six Kordex images and destination digests have not been verified.
dependencies.failureBehavior: Local archive staging does not imply registry population; any missing or changed destination blocks bootstrap.
dependencies.nextAction: Registry administrator publishes approved images and supplies the read-only destination verification report.
dependencies.owner: Private registry administrator
dependencies.requiredInputOrDecision: Customer-operated ingestion using approved mappings, followed by a read-only digest/architecture report and non-secret destination configuration.

dependencies.acceptanceCondition: The customer manifest and reviewed configuration bind the approved project, region/zone, disposable label, one-server/two-worker topology, private-only networking, e2-medium profile, and budget policy.
dependencies.description: The currently tracked project, region, zone, lab identity, topology, and design still require explicit customer confirmation; they are not live-state proof.
dependencies.failureBehavior: Unconfirmed or conflicting values block project review and planning.
dependencies.nextAction: GCP project owner confirms the intended disposable project and deployment location in an approved record.
dependencies.owner: Customer platform/GCP project owner
dependencies.requiredInputOrDecision: Confirm project kordex-fleet-platform-515416, region us-east1, zone us-east1-b, disposable lab label, one server/two workers, private-only VMs, no NAT, and cost ceiling policy.

dependencies.acceptanceCondition: An approved read-only review independently confirms the exact project identity/designation, effective principals and IAM, enabled APIs, relevant inventory, quotas, private-network safety, and absence of conflicting resources.
dependencies.description: Actual authenticated provider principal, impersonation target, project identity, API/IAM review, quota, image availability, IAP/OS Login, and serial recovery have not been verified.
dependencies.failureBehavior: Caller-asserted principal, missing approval, inadequate permissions, or recovery gap blocks planning.
dependencies.nextAction: After Phase B inputs are verified, request APPROVE_M3_PROJECT_REVIEW kordex-fleet-platform-515416. This phrase authorizes project review only.
dependencies.owner: GCP identity, security, access, and project owners
dependencies.requiredInputOrDecision: Independently sourced live identity/project attestation and customer-approved API, IAM, quota, IAP/OS Login, and serial-console review evidence.
dependencies.validationCommand: Customer-authorized read-only project review after APPROVE_M3_PROJECT_REVIEW <project_id>; Phase A runs no cloud command.

dependencies.acceptanceCondition: The billing owner provides current headroom evidence and an itemized 90-day maximum, including stopped-instance licensing and cleanup, that fits under $300 with the approved reserve.
dependencies.description: Current pricing, billing headroom, resource duration, and total expected spend have not been verified; USD 300 is only the hard ceiling.
dependencies.failureBehavior: Missing headroom, uncertain estimate, or ceiling breach prevents apply authorization.
dependencies.nextAction: Billing owner verifies current headroom and approves an itemized maximum estimate; project review does not authorize plan or apply.
dependencies.owner: GCP billing owner and customer budget approver
dependencies.requiredInputOrDecision: Current regional price inputs and itemized maximum estimate for three VMs/disks, snapshots, artifacts/registry, logs, transfer, DNS, recovery, taxes, and cleanup under USD 300.
dependencies.validationCommand: Customer billing owner records current region pricing, actual headroom, duration and teardown; no billing command is run in Phase A.

dependencies.acceptanceCondition: The approved configuration and live checks establish private DNS/routes, relay and mirror reachability, valid certificate chains/SAN mappings, IAP-only administration, serial recovery, and no public VM ingress or fallback.
dependencies.description: Customer private route, DNS pinning, relay mTLS certificates/SAN mapping, firewall rules, mirrors, and independent recovery path are not deployed or verified.
dependencies.failureBehavior: Local simulation or certificate inspection cannot satisfy live route verification; any identity/routing mismatch blocks.
dependencies.nextAction: Customer network/PKI owners implement and document the approved private route; run connectivity only after its exact approval.
dependencies.owner: Customer network and PKI administrators
dependencies.requiredInputOrDecision: Approved relay/private CIDRs and routes, private DNS records, trusted certificate chains and URI SAN mapping, TCP/18443 relay and TCP/443 mirror access, IAP/serial recovery evidence.

dependencies.acceptanceCondition: The guarded plan is independently reviewed against its exact digest, inputs, identity, project, images, topology, and cost; apply receives its separate exact authorization.
dependencies.description: No current reviewed Terraform plan, separate apply authorization, or cost-approved plan record exists.
dependencies.failureBehavior: Stale or changed plan, missing review, expired approval, or context drift prevents apply.
dependencies.nextAction: After project review, request APPROVE_M3_PLAN kordex-fleet-platform-515416 for plan only; after independent review, separately request APPROVE_M3_APPLY kordex-fleet-platform-515416.
dependencies.owner: Independent deployment approver and separate apply approver
dependencies.requiredInputOrDecision: Exact plan digest bound to reviewed inputs, principal, project, images, executable/context, and cost; separate explicit apply approval.

dependencies.acceptanceCondition: The customer-rooted, current, unexpired risk approval binds the exact organization, project, lab, OS, image self-link and ID, rationale, and independently accepted reviewer decision.
dependencies.description: The residual Compute Engine boot-disk image create-time TOCTOU risk has not been accepted by an independently authorized customer approver for each exact image.
dependencies.failureBehavior: Missing, invalid, expired, unsigned, caller-asserted, or wrong-image risk acceptance keeps qualification BLOCKED.
dependencies.nextAction: Customer risk owner signs and obtains independent review of the exact image-scoped residual-risk record after trust is configured.
dependencies.owner: Customer infrastructure risk owner and independent security reviewer
dependencies.requiredInputOrDecision: Root-signed exact-scope approval for organization/person/project/lab/platform/image self-link/image ID, timestamp, expiry, rationale, signature, and independent trust verification.

dependencies.acceptanceCondition: Post-apply verification confirms exactly three expected VMs and boot disks in the approved project/zone, with matching source image IDs, roles, machine IDs, OS releases, architecture, and K3s node identities.

dependencies.failureBehavior: Any missing or mismatched image/host identity blocks qualification and preserves the lab for investigation.
dependencies.nextAction: Do not deploy in Phase A; perform the separately approved post-create identity check only after approved apply.
dependencies.owner: Customer infrastructure operator and independent lab reviewer
dependencies.requiredInputOrDecision: After separately approved deployment, identity evidence for every lab VM including sourceImage/sourceImageId and independently measured OS/machine/Node identity.
dependencies.validationCommand: python3 scripts/self_managed_lab.py apply --project-id <approved-project-id> <approved-input-arguments> (guarded apply; not authorized in Phase A)

dependencies.acceptanceCondition: The approved live connectivity test verifies authenticated private management/relay/mirror paths and independently demonstrates IAP/serial recovery without public ingress or fallback.
dependencies.description: Live relay-to-workstation API and lab-agent mTLS connectivity, retry/recovery, IAP/OS Login, and serial-console paths have not been tested in the customer network.
dependencies.failureBehavior: Loopback, mock, or synthetic cert tests remain local-only; live path failures block preflight.
dependencies.nextAction: After deployment and network approval, request APPROVE_M3_CONNECTIVITY_TEST for a live route test only.
dependencies.owner: Customer network operator and Kordex operator
dependencies.requiredInputOrDecision: Approved private route evidence, live endpoint/certificate/mapping/request evidence, and independent recovery-path verification.

dependencies.acceptanceCondition: The existing read-only preflight passes for the approved three-node baseline, exact host/image identities, artifacts, trust, network, peer/workload health, recovery controls, and target confirmation.
dependencies.description: No per-platform live preflight has verified exact host, machine/Node identity, artifact locks, health, recovery, replay protection, and lab-only execution gate.
dependencies.failureBehavior: Any missing/expired prerequisite or unsafe target blocks; preflight must not mutate hosts.
dependencies.nextAction: After connectivity, request APPROVE_M3_PREFLIGHT for read-only preflight only.
dependencies.owner: Customer lab operator and safety owner
dependencies.requiredInputOrDecision: Approved disposable Debian 13 and RHEL 9.8+ hosts, complete trusted artifacts, recovery readiness, image risk acceptance, and exact target confirmations.

dependencies.acceptanceCondition: Every scenario-specific fault has an approved target, bounded mechanism and duration, abort criteria, restoration procedure, independent restoration check, and named approvers.
dependencies.description: Customer-approved bounded injection and restoration mechanisms for seven manual failure scenarios are not supplied or tested.
dependencies.failureBehavior: Unbounded shutdown, network change, reboot suppression, or untested restoration keeps that row BLOCKED/NOT RUN.
dependencies.nextAction: Customer safety owner approves a bounded mechanism for each case; then request APPROVE_M3_FAULT_INJECT <scenario_id> <os_id> separately.
dependencies.owner: Customer safety owner and infrastructure/network/package owners
dependencies.requiredInputOrDecision: Per-scenario target allowlist, exact mechanism, maximum duration, restoration timeout/action, independent restoration check, abort criteria, and named approvers.
dependencies.validationCommand: See docs/m3-manual-failure-procedures.md; per-scenario mechanism and restoration must be customer-approved.

dependencies.acceptanceCondition: Each of the 22 distinct OS/scenario rows has genuine host execution, durable operation identity, verified recovery and baseline restoration, fresh signed evidence, and no unresolved failure or fence.
dependencies.description: None of the 22 canonical Debian 13/RHEL 9.8+ scenario records has been executed on approved real hosts in this repository phase.
dependencies.failureBehavior: No row can inherit another row's operation or evidence; uncertain mutation retains its safety fence and remains FAIL/NOT RUN.
dependencies.nextAction: After preflight, request APPROVE_M3_EXECUTE <scenario_id> <os_id> for each row separately; no approval is implied across OSes or scenarios.
dependencies.owner: Customer maintenance operator and independent safety observer
dependencies.requiredInputOrDecision: Eleven separately approved scenarios on each OS, unique host/operation identity, baseline restoration after every case, and genuine signed evidence.
dependencies.validationCommand: python3 scripts/self_managed_lab.py execute --help (each case requires a separate exact approval)

dependencies.acceptanceCondition: All 22 evidence packages pass signature, freshness, identity, integrity, replay, recovery, and baseline checks and have separate acceptance from an authorized independent reviewer.
dependencies.description: No complete set of 22 fresh, customer-corroborated, signed, non-replayed evidence rows has been independently accepted.
dependencies.failureBehavior: Any missing, synthetic, stale, duplicate, unsigned, misbound, or unreplayed evidence prevents row PASS and M3 acceptance.
dependencies.nextAction: After evidence verification, request APPROVE_M3_EVIDENCE_ACCEPT <scenario_id> <os_id> for each row separately.
dependencies.owner: Customer evidence custodian, distinct corroborator, independent reviewer
dependencies.requiredInputOrDecision: All host records, hashes, collector signatures, customer-origin corroboration, reviewer decisions, durable replay receipts, and restoration evidence in customer custody.

dependencies.acceptanceCondition: All official M3 exit criteria and 22 independent row acceptances are verified, the final independent review is recorded, and the exact final signoff authorization is present.
dependencies.description: M3 final sign-off is not authorized or supportable until every row and safety criterion is independently accepted.
dependencies.failureBehavior: Any row other than independently accepted PASS forces overall M3 NOT COMPLETE.
dependencies.nextAction: Only after all 22 rows independently pass, request APPROVE_M3_SIGNOFF.
dependencies.owner: Customer M3 authority and independent security reviewer
dependencies.requiredInputOrDecision: All 22 accepted rows, verified restoration/no unresolved fences, trust/replay/image-risk approvals, and final independent review.
